scope: The official hostapd 2.12 authenticator KAY setup wires the receive-PN getter but omits the setter callback. Reverse EAP v17 logs explicitly report the missing secy operation and accept delayed data.

The owned repair forwards the existing secy set_receive_lowest_pn callback to the existing driver API using hapd->drv_priv and the same receive_sa. It adds no new packet-number interpretation; the already justified zero-window Linux setter receives the KAY-computed value.
Original v17 binaries and failed observations remain unchanged. Full standard conformance, nonzero windows and replacement-SA overlap remain separate.
